title: JsonUI include ids — snake_case to camelCase, shared test vectors
notes: The spelling an include gives the ids inside it, as codegen writes it: sjui_tools/lib/swiftui/include_expander.rb and kjui_tools/lib/compose/include_expander.rb (to_camel_case, combine_with_prefix) — the ids a generated screen has, so every other reader agrees with them. Each part after the first is Ruby's String#capitalize: its first letter up, the REST DOWN, so an upper-case part is not kept (verify_2FA_form -> verify2faForm). Columns: camel = to_camel_case(input), an include's own id with no prefix above it; combined = combine_with_prefix(prefix, input), an id inside an include (or a nested include's id) under a prefix, whose first letter goes up only when it is a-z; unprefixed = combine_with_prefix(null, input), an id under no prefix, left alone. Written by running the two Ruby functions (they agree on every row); their specs hold them to it. Read by: jui_tools' normalizer (jui_tools/tests/test_camel_case_vectors.py), the sjui/kjui include_expander and rjui snake_to_camel_id specs, the SwiftJsonUI and KotlinJsonUI dynamic IncludeExpander tests, and the web include-id helper.
